item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Kesha - live audio or video for 2013 performances
item.description:
i need the full audio or video (or both!) in HQ. this show had the longest and most complete setlist (for the North American Tour with Pitbull);

https://www.setlist.fm/setlist/kesha/2013/the-shoe-cincinnati-oh-3bd9e49c.html

  2. Crazy Kids
  3. We R Who We R
  4. Blow
  5. Gold Trans Am
  6. Dirty Love
  7. Take It Off

  9. Last Goodbye
  10. Supernatural
  11. Machine Gun Love
  12. Blah Blah Blah
  13. Your Love Is My Drug
  14. TiK ToK
    Encore:
  15. Love Into the Light
